scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.description: Sales CRM with calling and outreach
app.access_detail: Generate keys in account settings or create an OAuth app; trial entitlement not independently established.
app.surface: REST; leads, contacts and sales activity
app.note: API key is the Basic username with an empty password; OAuth is preferred for public apps.

mcp.scope: Read, safe-write and destructive-write scope groups

app.workflow: Retrieve a lead and its contacts
app.next_action: Confirm whether Close trial accounts include the API, then use a test key to retrieve a lead with associated contacts.
app.success_criterion: Record the trial entitlement source and retrieve the seeded lead using the documented Basic-key format.
app.alternative_action: For an existing authorized tenant, inspect lead-detail reads to map missing UI fields; prefer the documented API when it covers them.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
